title: Vesper and the Monsoon
author: Isandro Nakamura
blurb: Jonah Coldharbour, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
